name: Principal Coming
steps: Throw Away Trash: Drag glass bottles and wrappers into the trash can.
Load the Washer: Put dirty clothes into the washer-dryer.
Mop Spills: Use mop to clean floor liquid.
Straighten Blankets: Tap beds to fix blankets.
Wake Up Partier: Tap girl to wake her up.
Clear Table: Drag plates and cups into trash.
Cover Graffiti: Tap door to repaint white.
Clean Sink: Tap sink and mirror to clean.
Wipe Table: Clean sticky stains with cloth.
White Cat Reveal: Tap dust/fur → it’s a cat and it runs away.
